title: P3 operators as interfaces to ET vehicles

tellings.quote: Jake talked about, Jake Barber talked about who are these P3 operators go through a rigorous training program so they can become like almost like a machine human machine interface between the people controlling them and the ET vehicles.

plain: According to Steven Greer, a longtime UFO activist, there are people called P3 operators who go through hard training so they can act almost like a human link between the people who control them and alien vehicles. Greer says he is passing on what Jake Barber, a man who has spoken publicly about secret UFO work, described. If true, it would mean humans are trained to connect directly with craft from elsewhere.
